title: Multimodal Evaluation of Russian-language Architectures
reasoning: The paper introduces the MERA Multi benchmark which includes a specific ethics evaluation component. Specifically, the ruHHH-Image and ruHHH-Video tasks assess honesty, harmlessness, empathy, and lack of prejudice (explicitly naming religion as a sub-group). Furthermore, 'Ethics' is integrated into the benchmark's core knowledge taxonomy (Table 2) and skill assessment framework.
